                <artifactId>build-helper-maven-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>3.2.0</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>add-integration-test-sources</id>

            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-failsafe-plugin</artifactId>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <id>integration-test</id>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>integration-test</goal>
                            <goal>verify</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
                <configuration>
                    <!-- Test against the classes, not the repackaged Boot jar, whose classes sit under BOOT-INF. -->
                    <classesDirectory>${project.build.outputDirectory}</classesDirectory>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>

content.text:
The test is in the `processor` module. Run this from the repo root:

```sh
mvn -pl processor -am verify -Dtest=none -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false -Dit.test=S3ObjectMetadataReaderIT
```

- `-am` also builds `contract`, which `processor` depends on.
- `-Dtest=none` with `-Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false` skips the unit tests without failing the build.
- `-Dit.test=...` tells Failsafe to run only this IT.
- Docker needs to be running, because the test uses Testcontainers with LocalStack.

Files used:
- `processor/CLAUDE.md` (lines 28–30, which give this exact command)
- `processor/pom.xml` (Failsafe setup, and `src/test-integration/java` added as a test source)
- `processor/src/test-integration/java/com/_8x8/herd/device_logs/processor/storage/s3/S3ObjectMetadataReaderIT.java`
- `CLAUDE.md` (Commands section)
